sumInsured: Not specified (varies as per Policy Schedule)

great.name: PED waiting period (12 months)
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre -existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 12 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
great.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 12 months of continuous coverage, which is better than many senior-focused plans.

great.name: Restore benefit (Automatic Recharge) — usable for same illness too
great.quote: The Company agrees to automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured once in a policy year... (iii) Recharge amount can be utilized for same illness as well as different Illnesses.
great.explanation: After you fully use up Base SI + bonuses (and certain optional additional SI if opted), the policy restores up to base SI once per year and it can be used even for the same illness.

great.name: Built-in additional Sum Insured buffer via Add-on options (Accidental/Critical Illness additional SI) — activates after base SI exhaustion
great.quote: In case any Claim is made for Emergency Care of any Injury due to an Accident... the Company shall automatically provide an additional Sum Insured equal to the Sum Insured for In-patient Care... provided that: (i) The 'Additional Sum Insured for Accidental Hospitalization' shall be utilized only after the Sum Insured has been completely exhausted;
great.reference: Section 3.2.9 Optional Benefit: Additional Sum Insured for Accidental Hospitalization (also see 3.2.10 for Defined Critical Illnesses)
great.explanation: If you opt these covers, they provide extra Sum Insured that kicks in only after your base SI is exhausted (a strong protection against large claims). Limits/eligibility depend on Policy Schedule for the optional benefits.

good.name: Initial waiting period (30 days)
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident, provided the same are covered.
good.explanation: Standard 30-day initial waiting for illnesses (accidents covered immediately).

good.name: Specific illness waiting period (24 months)
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...
good.explanation: Standard 24-month waiting for specified diseases/procedures (e.g., cataract, hernia, piles, etc.).

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover (60 days)
good.quote: Under Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses, for a period of 60days immediately prior to the Insured Person's date of admission to the Hospital
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 60 days before admission, linked to an admissible hospitalization.

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover (90 days)
good.quote: Under Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses, for a period of 90 days immediately after the Insured Person's date of discharge from the Hospital
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 90 days after discharge, linked to an admissible hospitalization.

good.name: Domiciliary hospitalization covered (with conditions)
good.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person... for the Medical Expenses incurred towards Domiciliary Hospitalization... subject to the conditions specified below: (i) The Domiciliary Hospitalization continues for a period exceeding 3 consecutive days.
good.explanation: Home treatment is covered if medically necessary and exceeds 3 consecutive days, subject to listed disease restrictions under this benefit.

good.name: Modern/advanced treatments covered (listed advanced technology methods)
good.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person... for treatment taken through following advance technology methods: ... Robotic surgeries ... Stereotactic radio surgeries ...
good.explanation: Covers several listed modern treatment methods under inpatient/day care, up to Sum Insured (unless you opt the optional cover that introduces sub-limits for these methods).

good.name: NCB (Renewal bonus) — 25% per claim-free year, reduces on claim (does not reset to zero)
good.quote: enhance the Sum Insured by 25% flat, on a cumulative basis... (vii) In the event of a Claim occurring during any Policy Year, the accrued No Claim Bonus will be reduced at same rate at which it is accrued at the commencement of next Policy Year;
good.explanation: Sum Insured can grow by 25% each claim-free year (up to 100%). On a claim, it reduces by the same step rate (it is not stated to drop to zero immediately).

bad.name: Room rent limit exists (may be % of SI per day or capped to certain room type) leading to proportionate deductions
bad.quote: If the Insured Person is admitted in a Hospital room where the Room Category opted or Room Rent incurred is higher than the eligible Room Category/ Room Rent as specified in|the Policy Schedule, then, a. The Policyholder/Insured Person shall bear the ratable proportion of the total Associate Medical Expenses...
bad.explanation: This policy can have room rent/room category limits as per the Policy Schedule. If you take a higher room than eligible, the insurer applies proportionate (ratable) deductions on associated medical expenses, increasing out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Consumables / non-medical items not covered (out-of-pocket)
bad.quote: Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure - i to Policy Terms & Conditions).
bad.reference: Section 4.2 Specific Exclusions, point 1 + Annexure I (Non-medical items list includes e.g., "GLOVES", "MASK", etc.)
bad.explanation: Consumables and many non-medical items (e.g., gloves, masks, kits, etc. as per annexure) are excluded, which can create significant hospital bill out-of-pocket.

bad.name: Disease sub-limits possible (if opted via Optional Benefit: Sub-Limit on Specified Diseases)
bad.quote: If this Optional Benefit is opted, then there shall be sub-limits on listed treatments and procedures up to the amount specified against each treatment and procedures in the Policy Schedule and Company's liability shall be limited to such extent. Listed Treatments and Procedures are as follows: (i) Treatment of Cataract (ii) Treatment of Total Knee Replacement ...
bad.reference: Section 3.2.6 Optional Benefit: Sub-Limit on Specified Diseases
bad.explanation: If you choose this optional benefit, major treatments can be capped by sub-limits (e.g., cataract, knee replacement, cancer, dialysis, etc.), which can materially reduce claim payout versus full SI coverage.

bad.name: Co-pay can become mandatory 20% outside Smart Select hospital list (if Smart Select optional benefit is chosen)
bad.quote: If this Optional Benefit is opted... If the Insured Person takes Medical Treatment in hospitals other than those listed in Annexure – III... shall bear a Co Payment of 20% on each and every Claim... (ii) However, no such additional co-payment shall be applicable if treatment is availed in the hospitals listed in Annexure III
bad.explanation: If you opt Smart Select for premium reduction, you may pay 20% co-pay on every claim when treated outside the specified hospital list (Annexure III). This is a meaningful cost trade-off.

unclear.name: Default co-payment (base plan) not explicitly stated in the wording
unclear.quote: The Co-payment proportion (if applicable) shall be borne by the Insured Person on each Claim...
unclear.reference: General Conditions Applicable to all the Benefits and Optional Benefits, point 3
unclear.explanation: The document defines co-payment and says it applies 'if applicable', but does not clearly state whether the base policy has 0% co-pay or a mandatory co-pay by default. Verify from Policy Schedule.

unclear.name: Cashless hospital network size not stated
unclear.quote: Cashless Facility means a facility extended by the insurer... directly made to the network Provider...
unclear.explanation: Cashless is available at network providers, but the number of network hospitals is not provided in this wording. Check insurer network list/website for your city and plan.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
